# speckit-plan Skill

Use to turn an approved spec into an implementation plan.

## Rules

1. Read `AGENTS.md`, the plan template, and the feature `spec.md`.
2. Check the plan against every rule in `AGENTS.md`.
3. Show only affected paths in Project Structure.
4. Define technical direction, risks, and validation.
5. Write to `.specify/specs/NNN-feature/plan.md`.
